sources.title: Security Incident Recovery Update #4
claims: 95% aggregate replenishment reported.
XRP and RLUSD are 100% backed among named top-ten assets, per Binance.
Phase-one withdrawals scheduled 06:00–09:00 UTC November 1; XRP included.
Deposits remain open; remaining 5% is less-liquid assets outside top ten.
limitations: Company claims pending full cryptographic PoR.
Schedule is not proof withdrawals are live.
XRP-specific purchases and recovered stolen XRP are undisclosed.

sources.title: Circle Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
claims: Circle SBI Japan K.K. is 50%-owned VIE controlled and consolidated by Circle; SBI has non-controlling interest.
No significant JV operating results to June 30, 2026.
Circle Coinbase distribution costs: $324.6M Q2, $655.3M H1 2026.
USDC Mint Q2 gross flows: $83.004B minted, $86.784B redeemed; H1 $156.543B minted, $158.540B redeemed.
Circle reports 27% USDC market share and 7.01M meaningful wallets at June 30.
limitations: Mint/redeem are gross Circle Mint flows, not net circulating supply.
JV scale and XRPL routing not established.
Distribution costs are not Coinbase net profit.

sources.title: SBI investment in Circle and Ripple shareholding disclosure
claims: SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei each invested $25M in Circle, $50M combined.
SBI reported approximately 9% Ripple equity ownership as of June 9, 2025.
The release describes the planned 50/50 SBI-Circle USDC distribution JV.
limitations: 9% Ripple stake is dated and not reverified currently.
Ripple equity is not XRP ownership.
Circle equity does not prove XRP bridge use.

sources.title: SBI Group $200M Evernorth PIPE investment
claims: SBI Group announced a $200M cash contribution to Evernorth PIPE.
SBI described the financing as supporting an XRP treasury strategy, including primarily open-market XRP acquisitions.
limitations: Cash is pooled with other investors; no dollar-for-dollar purchase allocation.
Does not establish current XRP balance or encumbrance.

sources.title: Evernorth completes business combination
claims: Business combination closed October 9; ticker XRPN began trading October 12.
Evernorth reported approximately 473M XRP at closing and approximately $300M gross cash proceeds.
SBI Group and Ripple were named among investors.
limitations: Closing figures are not current balances.
Gross proceeds are not cash remaining after purchases and expenses.

sources.title: Evernorth 424B3 prospectus and capital structure
claims: 473,276,430 XRP at October 9 closing: 84,365,876 cash-purchased for about $214.1M, 261,919,096 private-placement in-kind, 126,791,458 Ripple contribution plus a 200,000-XRP tranche requiring attribution review.
As of October 22, SBI held 9,431,914 Class A shares (36.1% of class) and 2,359,038 Class C shares (7.5% of class).
Ripple facility: $10M limit, about $9.7M drawn as of October 7, 3.81% interest, repayable within five business days after closing or earlier on demand.
Potential $76.8M equity line and $30M 4% convertible notes due 2031 are disclosed.
limitations: Cash purchase used pooled subscription cash, not attributable solely to SBI.
473M is a closing figure, not current verified balance.
20.5% combined share-count estimate is derived, not fully diluted company-reported ownership.
Equity line is potential, not confirmed drawn.
No XRP security interest established in reviewed Ripple facility terms.

sources.title: Evernorth XRPN XRP holdings and custody-wallet attribution
claims: At ledger 108037105, approximately 103,129,905 XRP attributed to 13 Evernorth custody wallets.
Approximately 370,346,663 XRP moved outside the attributed wallet set; destinations not attributed; latest identified movement October 22.
Tracker describes BitGo Trust custody, 2-of-3 multisig and disabled master key.
limitations: Outflow is not proof of sale, exchange deposit, DeFi or collateral.
103.13M is the attributed subset, not complete company balance.
Wallet labels and custody attribution are third-party analysis.

sources.title: SBI Remit Ripple solution using XRP as bridge currency
claims: SBI Remit announced XRP bridge-currency remittance corridors to the Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia.
The described flow uses XRP as bridge currency and local payout partners including Tranglo.
The stated rationale includes reducing pre-funded nostro/vostro requirements.
limitations: Current corridor volumes and active status are not disclosed.
Not all SBI/Ripple payments necessarily use XRP.

sources.title: SBI Information Meeting 2025 — Circle SBI Japan / SBI Circle Holdings name mapping
claims: SBI maps English name Circle SBI Japan K.K. to Japanese name SBI Circle Holdings K.K.
Presentation identifies 50/50 SBI/Circle ownership and USDC distribution/payment-service-provider purpose.
SBI VC Trade public USDC offering began March 26, 2025.
limitations: No current transaction volumes.
Circle Q2 2026 filing says no significant operating results to June 30.
JV purpose does not establish XRP/XRPL use.
